prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Katy, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1473; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state whether you consent to having this conversation recorded.

A: Yes, I consent.

Q: Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was driving east on a road in Katy, Texas, and I was turning left into a shopping center parking lot. I had my blinker on and was waiting for a gap in oncoming traffic.

Q: What happened next?

A: A vehicle coming from the opposite direction hit the front driver's side of my car. I didn't see it coming fast enough to avoid it. I felt a hard jolt and my car spun a little before stopping.

Q: Were you injured at the scene?

A: I was sore right away. My neck snapped back and forth, and my lower back hurt. I didn't think it was serious at first, but by that evening the pain was worse.

Q: Did you receive any medical treatment?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic the next day. They diagnosed me with a neck strain and a lower back strain and gave me muscle relaxers and a referral to physical therapy.

Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?

A: Yes. I have stiffness when I turn my head, and I can't sit for long periods without my back aching. I've missed a few days of work because of it.

Q: Was anyone else in your vehicle?

A: No, I was alone.

Q: Is there anything you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I was being careful and had stopped before I started my turn. I'm hoping this gets resolved so I can get my treatment covered.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.

A: Thank you.
